Third-party STEP files used by the direct-edit tests (tests/test_direct_edit.cpp,
docs/modeling/README.md#direct-edit). Each is copied unchanged.

From BenchCAD (https://github.com/BenchCAD/BenchCAD-main), CodeEdit/test_data/steps/:
  topup_ball_knob_axial_hole_rev_orig.step, topup_ball_knob_axial_hole_rev_gt.step,
  battery_holder_box_y_f130_orig.step, battery_holder_box_y_f130_gt.step,
  ball_knob_cylinder_radius_f130_orig.step, ball_knob_cylinder_radius_f130_gt.step
Each _orig/_gt pair differs by one edit, which the CadQuery source beside it
(CodeEdit/test_data/codes/) states. BenchCAD's repository is MIT; its datasets
hosted elsewhere are CC-BY-4.0, which this notice also attributes.
